race.description: Iron Horse Equine Nutrition Arthrsyn Plus Mdn Hcp
race.comment: MY TESTIMONY (2) is the one to beat after a strong Northam placing two starts back and a forgivable latest run when wide throughout and hampered late, yet still only beaten four and a half lengths. She is third-up, has a 3kg claim, and her five placings from 10 runs around 1100m make her a hot chance. PHOTOSYNTHESIS (4) is the danger after being beaten half a length at York as favourite, with an early block adding context to that defeat and her overall season form keeping her close. NICE SORT (12) resumes after six months and has a Belmont Park fourth from last campaign that reads well enough for this. In the mix. MAJESTIC VIEW (11) has been finishing better than the form figures suggest and first-time blinkers give her a genuine chance to sharpen off a close York sixth.
